default.description: Default (cross-platform) capabilities for Corvux. The fs plugin is not registered and no fs:* permissions are granted — every roost read/write goes through a Rust IPC command (commands/files.rs), which enforces RoostFs path scoping. The renderer cannot reach disk except via those IPC commands. Do not add fs:* permissions without an audit. Mobile-only plugin permissions (saf, multicast-lock, ios-picker) live in mobile.json; desktop-only ones live in desktop.json.

desktop.description: Desktop-only permissions. The auto-updater plugin (`tauri-plugin-updater`) is not available on Android/iOS — Tauri's mobile targets don't bundle the updater binary, so referencing `updater:default` in the cross-platform capability breaks `cargo build --target aarch64-linux-android`. Splitting the capability per-platform keeps updater-driven release flow on desktop while letting the mobile builds compile.

mobile.description: Mobile-only (Android + iOS) capabilities for Corvux. Holds the permissions for the mobile-only plugins: tauri-plugin-saf (Android Storage Access Framework folder picker + document ops), tauri-plugin-multicast-lock (Android WifiManager.MulticastLock for mDNS sync discovery), and tauri-plugin-ios-picker (iOS UIDocumentPicker + security-scoped bookmarks). These plugins are registered on all platforms (desktop builds get no-op stubs), but only mobile actually invokes them — so they're scoped here instead of the cross-platform default capability. Audit 2026-06-08, LOW-10.
